correctness.rationale: PASS: Every Heawood perfect matching is a 7-permutation respecting the explicit Fano incidence; exhaustive independent enumeration among 5040 permutations gives exactly 24. Fano incidence girth six implies changing exactly three matched point partners is equivalent to one alternating hexagon. Independent 276-pair adjacency enumeration gives 84 edges, all degree7; all 24 BFS rows give layers (1,7,14,2) and intersection array {7,4,1;1,2,7}. Distance-three triples are eight antipodal classes with one neighbor in every other class. Published uniqueness for the array identifies the Klein graph; the finite adjacency and metric results are independently exact.

evidence: Uniqueness of the Klein graph from its distance-regular intersection array identifies any constructed graph with that array, but does not prove the flip graph has that array.
